subject.title: [Feature]: Add guarded keyboard shortcuts for session/agent switching in Control UI

question: Should Control UI support guarded positional/cyclic session or agent switching shortcuts, and if so what exact keys, target ordering, and focus scope should be the product contract?
rationale: The current code has a usable picker/sidebar path, but adding global or dashboard-level session shortcuts creates new UX semantics around key conflicts, visible ordering, selected agent fallback, and session-state changes that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Approve Narrow Session Shortcuts
options.body: Adopt a defined key map and ordering based on the visible sidebar/session list, guarded outside editable targets, then implement it as a focused Control UI change.

options.title: Fold Into Sessions Workspace
options.body: Keep this request open only as part of the broader sessions workspace design so shortcut behavior follows a future tab/list overview contract.

options.title: Decline Global Switching Chords
options.body: Keep session switching in the picker/sidebar and command palette if maintainers decide the key conflicts and hidden state changes are not worth adding.

recommendation.title: Approve Narrow Session Shortcuts
recommendation.body: Adopt a defined key map and ordering based on the visible sidebar/session list, guarded outside editable targets, then implement it as a focused Control UI change.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest recent owner of the session-first sidebar and session management foundation that would define the target order and fallback semantics.
